checks.reason: Genetic validation is proposed without necessary matched rescue-delivery/vector and detection-background controls and their roles; the supplied existing null/loading observation does not constitute those prospective procedural controls.

No prospective background/linearity calibration with an acceptance criterion and failed-calibration action for the proposed band measurement.
No quantitative band-intensity definition with normalization denominator and weak/saturated-signal rules.
